adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show no sustained shift-and-return pattern across any candidate interval (P1:687-692, P2:695-696, P3:698-701). P1 spans 5 days but interior points lack persistent offset; E and U show noisy fluctuations without coherent platform. P2 is only 1 day—too short for a genuine temporary platform. P3 (698–701) shows no clear opposing return; surrounding motion is smooth and non-reversing. Numerical tool evidence rejects both visual intervals. Onset offsets are inconsistent with observed station-scaled behavior (e.g., P3 onset implies large jump not seen in raw data). No pair satisfies the definition of a temporary offset: sustained shift followed by opposing return on same axes.
